description: This Java source file defines a final utility class 'Helper' within an Android Autofill Service SDK module. It provides static methods for extracting autofillable fields from assist structures and requests, and for showing messages via Toasts. The class is tightly coupled with Android Autofill APIs and handles assist structures, autofill IDs, and view hints.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for autofill handling, extracting autofillable fields from assist structures and fill requests, and displaying messages.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a toast message and logs it, given a Context and message.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields
methods.description: Extracts autofillable fields from a FillRequest by retrieving the latest assist structure.

methods.name: getLatestAssistStructure
methods.description: Helps retrieve the AssistStructure associated with the latest fill context within a FillRequest.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields (overloaded)
methods.description: Parses an AssistStructure to find and return a map of autofill hints to AutofillIds.

methods.name: addAutofillableFields
methods.description: Recursively adds autofillable ViewNodes from the assist structure to the fields map, considering hints and autofill types.
